messages.author: f4108b5f63668d70
messages.subject: SparkR pull requests
parts:
Hi all

A quick update on the merge plan that I outlined last week. We have now created a Spark fork at https://github.com/amplab-extras/spark and I'd like to particularly thank Davies for his help in porting our code (with history [1]) over to the new repository.

There are still a couple of PRs open on the old repository [2] that I'd like to include before making an official merge PR to Apache Spark, but in the meanwhile I'll be asking developers to send a version of their PRs to this repository as well.

We have an updated README for building, running SparkR at https://github.com/amplab-extras/spark/blob/R/R/README.md and this might be especially useful for those who are new to Spark development.

Please let me know if you have any questions / clarifications

Thanks
Shivaram

[1] For example see the per-line history in RDD.R at https://github.com/amplab-extras/spark/blame/R/R/pkg/R/RDD.R

[2] https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg/pulls

messages.author: f4108b5f63668d70
messages.subject: Re: SparkR pull requests
parts:
Yeah I have a list of things which we should do after the merge. These include:

- Adding a CONTRIBUTING.md in SparkR-pkg which will show up when new PRs are created
- Update SparkR README and website (its in gh-pages branch) with pointers to new repo
- Clean up SparkR JIRA and move required entries to Spark JIRA
- Ask subscribers of this mailing list to subscribe to user / dev list of Spark

Thanks
Shivaram

On Thu, Mar 19, 2015 at 11:04 AM, Davies Liu <dav...@databricks.com> wrote:
Thanks for the update. 

Should we update the README of SparkR-pkg to say we’re moving into Spark, and put a link about how to contribute? Maybe we can do it after the merge.

-- 
Davies Liu
